content: When the Bus Mirroring module is initialized or when Mir- ror_SwitchDestNetwork is called to activate a FlexRay ( MirrorDestNetwork- FlexRay ), IP ( MirrorDestNetworkIp ), or proprietary ( MirrorDestNetworkCdd ) destination bus, the Bus Mirroring module shall activate a new destination frame buffer and reset the SequenceNumber to 0 .
